search_text: published ZDI-15-077 ZDI-CAN-2631 Microsoft Internet Explorer CImgElement Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-03-10 CVE-2015-0056 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-0056 6.8 ['Microsoft'] ['Internet Explorer'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The vulnerability relates to how Internet Explorer processes HTML img elements. By adding an img element to a document fragment and then performing certain manipulations, an attacker can force a CImgElement object in memory to be reused after it has been freed. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the current process. Microsoft has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Microsoft Internet Explorer CImgElement Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The vulnerability relates to how Internet Explorer processes HTML img elements. By adding an img element to a document fragment and then performing certain manipulations, an attacker can force a CImgElement object in memory to be reused after it has been freed. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the current process.
